name: limits-off-paint-margin
description: test.md 'Texture, doodad and paste at the margin against Enforce Terrain Limits': Grass, size 3, one click each on the playable edge (695,500), the margin beside it (800,400) and its far end (940,300) of edge-last-step.w3m (camera 3456, 0, 3000; playable part to 3328, map to 4096), switch off (the default). MATCH (2026-11-15, branch we-specs-d2): the editor paints the margin as the playable part, with the switch on too (limits-on-paint-margin)

name: limits-on-paint-margin
description: limits-off-paint-margin with Enforce Terrain Limits ticked first (Scenario > Map Preferences in the editor, Map Properties > Preferences in Studio): the same ground. MATCH (2026-11-15)

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.mapInfo.open', 'preferences'); let box = null; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !box; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.map-info .form-body')].find((x) => x.querySelector('h2')?.textContent === 'Preferences'); const l = b && [...b.querySelectorAll('label.form-check')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Enforce terrain limits'); box = l?.querySelector('input') ?? null; if (!box) await wait(100); } if (!box) throw new Error('no Enforce terrain limits box'); if (!box.checked) box.click(); await wait(500);

name: limits-off-doodad-margin
description: a Summer Tree Wall (LTlt, the Doodad palette's first row, 1410,184) placed in the margin (800,400) and at its far end (940,300) of edge-last-step.w3m, switch off. Studio: the map's tree selected, Select In Tool Palette, the Objects tab, the same clicks. Ignored: the new trees' variation and scale (both editors draw them at random). MATCH (2026-11-15): both placed, on the tree's grid (3584, 0 and 3968, 384), with the switch on too

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await s.look.get('map/war3map.w3e.txt')(3584, 1024, { id: 'LTlt', x: 3584, y: 1024 }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas').focus(); const why = await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.selectInPalette'); if (why) throw new Error('Select In Tool Palette: ' + why); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: limits-off-paste-margin
